blocks.value: Every stock chart has two important axes that help us understand what we're looking at.
Imagine This: Your school calendar shows dates from left to right, while your report card shows marks from bottom to top. Stock charts combine these two ideas.
The horizontal (X) axis represents time. The vertical (Y) axis represents the stock's price.
If a point appears on March 1st at ₹500, it means the stock traded around ₹500 on that date.
Always read the axes before interpreting any chart.
